# manual (owner): Sales Hub, App Settings, Copilot: on, Turn audit on; Copilot Service admin center: Opt in, Copilot help pane with Use your organization's knowledge base, experience profile with Copilot features, Dataverse search on

# manual (owner): create by hand, marked (sample): opportunities Tailspin fleet: 40 e-bikes (account Tailspin Tours, contact Alex Demo, revenue 48,000, close date within 3 months, 2 products, 1 quote), Proseware courier trial (no account, no products), Litware rental refresh (empty industry, no contact, 1 product), two won opportunities for history; cases CAS-1001 (long description), CAS-1002 (title Battery issue, description: Battery does not charge.), CAS-1003; knowledge articles KA-0001 (published), KA-0002 (draft), KA-0004 (published, pt-PT), KA-0005 (table only), as in src/data/sample

screens.name: copilot-settings
steps: Window 1: Sales Hub (Sales trial environment), App Settings, General Settings, Copilot: show Copilot on and Turn audit on (or audit already on)
Window 2: Copilot Service admin center, Support experience, Productivity, Copilot settings: show opt in done and the data movement status
Record the real state, whatever it is; place the two windows side by side or capture them one after the other
mask: organisation URL (crm4 address) in every address bar
screens.note: Open the Sales Hub app from its own address (the Sales trial org URL) and the Copilot Service admin center from the Customer Service trial; url above is only the starting point.

screens.name: opportunity-summary
steps: Open Sales Hub in the Sales trial environment, Opportunities
Open Tailspin fleet: 40 e-bikes and expand the Copilot summary banner
Open Proseware courier trial (no account, no products) and expand its summary
Keep a second window with the Learn attribute list (estimatedvalue, estimatedclosedate, parentcontactid, parentaccountid) for comparison; record both exactly as shown
mask: organisation URL in the address bar
contact e-mail of Alex Demo if it is a real address

screens.name: case-summary
steps: Open Copilot Service workspace in the Customer Service trial environment
Open case CAS-1001 (full description) and expand the Copilot case summary card
Open CAS-1002 (six words: Battery does not charge.) and show what the summary card does: a message, an empty card or a summary
Record the real behaviour; if CAS-1002 still gets a summary the 38 word rule text must change
mask: organisation URL in the address bar

screens.name: ask-a-question
steps: In Copilot Service workspace open the Copilot help pane, tab Ask a question, with the organisation knowledge base as the source
Ask: How do I reset error E21 on the Contoso Volt display? (published article KA-0001) and open Check sources
Ask: What does the hub warranty cover? (only the draft article KA-0002 exists)
Record both answers and citations exactly as shown
mask: organisation URL in the address bar

teardown: # manual (owner): delete the demo records marked (sample): opportunities, accounts, contacts, cases, knowledge articles
